# MeterMesh

> Verifiable AI work delivered over XMTP and grounded in X Layer receipts.

Canonical integration guide: /docs/
Service manifest: /.well-known/metermesh.json
Public HTTP read surfaces: /openapi.json
Captured offline evidence: /evidence/captured-session.json
Anchored signed live proof: /evidence/anchored-live-proof.json
Signed live reverted receipt proof: /evidence/reverted-live-proof.json
Source: https://github.com/Alike001/metermesh
Protocol schema: https://github.com/Alike001/metermesh/blob/main/packages/protocol/src/schema.ts
Explanation schema: https://github.com/Alike001/metermesh/blob/main/packages/ai/src/schema.ts

Execution is defined by signed MeterMesh envelopes carried over XMTP. No HTTP execution endpoint is published. The v1 public verifier creates no voucher and moves no funds. Buyer review is recorded as an unsigned preview. MeterMesh includes a deterministic, replay-safe verifier for the published OKX MPP EIP-712 voucher shape, but it does not open sessions or settle them. The proof-anchor contract is deployed on X Layer Testnet at 0xE9827c90f742C593F966B7E878e2a13fdC8f1683, and one fresh signed live proof is anchored in transaction 0xf518187f13559ab46cfa1c85d64089a8c99eca8d1ee9d77a41840046f0e7aa5a. OKX MPP session mutation remains deferred until chain 1952 support is confirmed.
